Are you ready to own something big?  Automox  is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U!  
 OUR TECH STACK 
 
 Backend Languages: Go, TypeScript, Java, PHP
 
 Frontend Languages: TypeScript, Vue 3, Tauri (Rust)
 
 Operating Systems: Windows, Linux, MacOS
 
 Databases/Data Tools: PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, S3 
 
 OVERVIEW 
 Our Engineering team builds products that autonomously manage endpoint configuration, security, and patching across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices. We value a "one team" mentality, empowering our engineers with autonomy, collaboration, and meaningful ownership of impactful solutions. At Automox, you’ll do your best work, grow your career, and see the direct impact of your contributions. 
 You are a curious software developer who is dedicated to your craft and enjoys solving big problems; you write code that you are proud of and can hit the ground running with support from the team. You understand that SaaS software delivery necessitates innovation and speed of execution. You want to be a part of a creative and enterprising team with challenging problems to solve. You pride yourself in owning problems but don’t want to work in a vacuum to solve them. Collaborating with the team to come up with the best solution for your customer is what fuels your fire.  
 WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 
 
 Research, design, develop, secure and solutions that facilitate communications with over 2 millionAutomox agents deployed globally. 
 Extend, enhance, and evolve event driven services to provide new and exciting features in the Automox platform and in our endpoint software. 
 Contribute to continuous improvement by testing, performance tuning, refactoring, making usability improvements, and automation. 
 Evaluate technical options, make a clear recommendation, and move forward in a way that invites feedback and iteration. 
 Operate with a quality-first mindset. Your approach to testing sets you apart from your peers. 
 Make data-driven decisions. You understand the impact of your development before it reaches production. 
 
 BACKGROUND AND SKILLS REQUIRED 
 
 Programming experience in Golang or Java is preferred although we'll consider polyglots. The right candidate will show versatility writing and developing software in a variety of languages over their career. 
 3 - 5 years of experience designing, developing, testing, and monitoring applications deployed in a high availability SaaS environment. 
 Professional experience shipping frontend features in a modern JavaScript framework using TypeScript. You don’t need to be a UI specialist, but you should be comfortable owning the UI half of a feature you built the backend for. 
 Experience building production applications in cloud environments (AWS) with a strong emphasis on security best practices. 
 Enjoy scaling microservice architectures and large-scale event ingestion platforms. Have familiarity scaling websockets, real-time messaging systems (Kafka, MQTT), and non-relational database systems like DynamoDB, and DevOps. 
 Excellent communicator, thrives within a tightly knit, cross-functional remote team environment. 
 Impactful collaborator working with other engineers, Product Managers, Program Managers and Technical Support. 
 
 NICE TO HAVE 
 
 Experience building desktop or cross-platform applications. 
 Experience with software that runs on customer endpoints across macOS, Windows, or Linux (such as agents, installers, or system services). 
 Experience writing automated end-to-end tests (Python, Playwright, or similar)

Who are we and why should you join us? 
 BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution. 
 As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together. 
 What are we looking for? 
 We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates. 
 You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision. 
 What technologies will you work with? 
 We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software. 
 
 Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis 
 Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS 
 Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery 
 
 We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems. 
 What will you do? 
 
 You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement. 
 You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code. 
 You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners. 
 You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs. 
 You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems. 
 You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas. 
 You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms. 
 You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code. 
 You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments. 
 You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience. 
 You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment. 
 You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks. 
 You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision. 
 
 What will you NOT do? 
 
 You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent comp

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does:  play video games.  Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. 
 We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early. 
 What you'll be doing 
 
 Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end. 
 Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes. 
 Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce. 
 Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules. 
 Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects. 
 Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build. 
 Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams. 
 Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards. 
 
 Automation Use Cases 
 
 FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing. 
 AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release. 
 AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle. 
 Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines. 
 
 What you should have 
 
 3-5+ years of QA automation experience. 
 Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance. 
 Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades. 
 Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment. 
 Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent). 
 Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds. 
 Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows. 
 Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support. 
 Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus. 
 Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation. 
 Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries. 
 Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers. 
 Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

 Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.

About  Valdera : 
 At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.  
 We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.  
 Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.  
 Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.  
 Role Description: 
 We are hiring a C hemical Data Scientist  to build and maintain the pipelines that keep Valdera's supplier and chemical product data accurate, current, and structured — the foundation every buyer and supplier relies on across Valdera's procurement platform. 
 Data quality plays a critical role at Valdera. When a buyer launches a request, they expect to be matched with the right suppliers and accurate specs on the first try. Delivering that depends on clean, current data — CAS numbers, specifications, certifications, and regulatory documents pulled from thousands of inconsistent, often messy sources. This requires strong data engineering fundamentals and a working knowledge of chemical industry data. For example, you might take dozens of differently structured chemical supplier catalogs and turn them into one clean, standardized product database.  
 You will take ownership of the full data pipeline — from scrapers and ETL workflows to data cleaning, matching, and classification models that connect suppliers to buyer requirements. You're energized by messy, real-world data and confident partnering with Supplier Management and Engineering to close coverage gaps. As a data-obsessed professional, you're dedicated to the accuracy our buyers and suppliers depend on. 
 Role Responsibilities: 
 
 
 Design and build pipelines to collect supplier data and chemical product information (specifications, CAS numbers, certifications, SDS/regulatory documents, NAICS classification of manufacturing plants) from supplier sites, distributor catalogs, trade databases, and other public and semi-structured sources 
 
 
 Develop and maintain web scrapers and automated ETL workflows to keep supplier and product data current at scale 
 
 
 Clean, normalize, and reconcile inconsistent supplier data into structured, standardized formats suitable for internal tools and analytics 
 
 
 Apply chemical domain knowledge to validate and enrich data — resolving product names, CAS numbers, synonyms, and specifications across suppliers 
 
 
 Evaluate and improve matching and classification models to map suppliers and products to buyer requirements, and to identify overlapping or equivalent chemical offerings 
 
 
 Partner with Supplier Management and Engineering to define data quality standards, identify gaps in supplier coverage, and prioritize new data sources. 
 
 
 Own pipeline health and data quality, and drive the KPIs that measure overall data coverage 
 
 
 Experience & Qualifications: 
 
 
 5+ years of experience in a data science, data engineering, or applied data role, ideally with exposure to messy, real-world or industrial datasets. 
 
 
 Working knowledge of chemistry or chemical industry data — comfort with CAS numbers, chemical properties, SDS documents, NAICS classification, and supplier certifications 
 
 
 Strong Python skills, with experience building web scrapers and data pipelines 
 
 
  Experience with data cleanin
